items.note: K1.1-K1.4 follow the proof at 741-765: the net change (JV+RG)x is independent of the scratch values, the central coefficients are |S∩T| mod 2 or (|S∩T|-1)/2 with the side wires cancelling the rest, and the three stages give (x,y)->(-y,x). The headline calls the stages 'three forward invocations', but stage 2 is the inverse schedule (731-733, 761). The setup h=100, triple indexing, N, m and the wire counts W (767-783) are never stated.

It is a single infer step: the invariant argument at 804-813 is only summarised, and the route formula eps_w D_sink D_source^{-1} appears only in its use in K4d.3.

errors.says: Three forward invocations of the network send (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a).
errors.paper: A forward invocation from X to Y at stage 1, the inverse forward schedule from Y to X at stage 2 (effecting X<-X-Y), and a forward invocation at stage 3; the middle stage is not a forward invocation.

errors.says: The layout makes each round of the transform one simultaneous layer.
errors.paper: Only rounds on the remaining K-bit chunks use the simultaneous layer. The at most b+1 rounds on prefix slots process their bits individually at cost O(TpdK).

errors.says: The complex network applies C^{⊗m} on every role.
errors.paper: The bare network gives C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates for X_a->Y_a and carries the exchange sign. C^{⊗m} on every role holds only after source and sink diagonal corrections and undoing the signed bank exchange (K5a.8 partly records the corrections).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route. It builds the fixed networks (K1-K3), the bit shear interface and rank-a matrix shear leading to the interchange recurrence O(Vu^tau) (K4a-K4e), and the phase interface with packed basis changes leading to the layer recurrence O(Vd^{lambda'}) (K5). These feed the synthetic transforms and convolution (D), resampling, chirp and permutation cancellation (E), then parameters, CRT, twist, the algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table (F1-F6), reaching O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}). It thins out at the base of the central construction: the network sizes h=100, N and m and the wire counts W are never defined, and the subspace labels (terminal labels, stage transitions, gate-label table) are asserted through the lemma quote rather than reconstructed. The fixed rational exponent list and the computed twist procedure are also missing.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch wires is stated and derived. The defining quantities are absent: h=100, data pairs indexed by triples a in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3. Later steps use N, m and W undefined, so the conservative verdict is mentioned.
K2 states that a common invertible frame commutes with pointwise linear gates, that the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and that each edge costs a change of frame D_vD_u^{-1}.

Nondegenerate labels from tensor products of triple-indicator lines, edges joining nested labels, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each losing h, are all stated. The ambient F^{⊗3} of dimension m is left implicit.
It states rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested U⊂V, with the N source edges at X_a as the exceptions, of rank one (2P_{U_a}).
It gives L=Ich and sum|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L by telescoping, then s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It gives L/N=100/539 and 101/539 below 1/2, a deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0), and hence s<Wm.
It gives M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m, others 0 to I), so the network applies H<-H+D on every role.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per edge, and s recursive calls per node.
Children have volume V/W and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). From eta>20·2^{-50} and log m<20 it gets s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, then F_k=O(e^tau) by the geometric sum.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving from C2 to C9: frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, the edge shears as recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only gap is the first link: the network's exchange and restoration are derived, but its defining sizes (h=100, N=binom(100,3)^3, m=h^3, triple-indexed banks) are never stated.
